subject: Discovery follow-up: demo scheduling (tight confirmation)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Lee <jamie.lee@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery follow-up: demo scheduling (tight confirmation)

Hi Jamie,

Thanks again for taking time earlier for the discovery call — really helpful to understand Atlas Retail's goals around in-line product recommendations and latency targets. Quick recap:
- Goal: reduce cart abandonment by surfacing contextual suggestions (POC scope: web checkout + email)
- SLOs: 95th percentile latency < 300ms for N=16 models, target throughput ~200 qps
- Success metrics: lift in conversion + 10–15% CTR on recommended items

Next step: technical deep dive + demo to walk through integration patterns (server-side SDK, streaming, and deployment options). Can you confirm one of the slots below? These are 30-min windows in PT. If you pick one I'll send a calendar invite and lock it — please confirm within 4 hours so I don't release the tentative hold.

Option A: Mon Aug 31, 10:00–10:30 AM PT
Option B: Mon Aug 31, 2:00–2:30 PM PT
Option C: Tue Sep 1, 2:00–2:30 PM PT

Agenda (attached): 1) architecture + integration patterns (10m) 2) demo (10m) 3) Q&A + next steps (10m).

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (call notes)

If you prefer a different time, send one or two alternatives and we'll work to accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | (415) 555-0147
Redwood Inference
